title: Al-Muqni'a
author: al-shaykh-al-mufid
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shaykh al-Mufid's compendium of Twelver belief and law, opening with the articles of faith and then running through worship, family, commerce and penalties. It is one of the earliest systematic Shia law books.
historicalContext: Al-Mufid led the Twelver community of Buyid Baghdad. His student al-Tusi wrote the Tahdhib al-Ahkam, one of the four canonical Shia hadith collections, as a commentary that supplies the hadith behind the rulings of al-Muqni'a.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
